title: Decision: open-source MCP — the client thinks locally, the server keeps a thin door (a metadata draft write entry for building; the data door for 问数), plus policy, version skew and the 问数 eval
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ② a decision card the maintainer asked for by name in the triage seat's thread, 2026-11-17 ~05:10Z: 「你调研之后用fable分析，立决策卡」.

Direction, verbatim:
- 「远程 MCP 直接改环境，这个没问题，但是思考的过程查技能查协议都可以在本地啊」
- 「工具只需要提供元数据写入口」
- 「mcp问数呢，也可以用类似的方案优化吗」
- 「mcp问数重点不应该是在开源项目吗？先把这个搞定了」

Analysis: triage's research, then an isolated contract-review-tier reviewer (Fable). It was given the facts and the maintainer's words, not triage's conclusions.

Prior rulings on this card: none. Related: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32591 (ruling A, human publish), cloud ADR-0112 D1, cloud ADR-0025 / ADR-0082, cloud `docs/design/pricing.md:113`, ADR-0149 (datasets), ADR-0151 (Proposed), objectstack-ai/objectstack#34632 (fleet v2, D8 MCP / 问数 epic).

## 维护者速读

- **你的方向成立，开源版已经有一大半：**
  - 本地写代码、本地检查，再用 `os deploy` 部署到自托管服务器。这条路 11 月 7 日已经上线：用 API 密钥，直接生效，破坏性改动要确认。
  - 更正：我之前在会话里说「`os deploy` 只对接云端」，那是过时的说法。
- **开源版缺的只是 MCP 上很薄的一个「元数据写入口」：** AI 写进去的都是草稿，由人在 Studio 审阅后发布。保存时服务器本来就会跑同一套检查。
- **规则和协议不必由服务器下发：** `@objectstack/skills`（约 240KB）和 `@objectstack/spec` 都已公开发布，客户端本地装同版本即可。
- **服务器只回答「这个环境里现在有什么」：** 已有的对象、字段、选项显示名、指标数据集和同义词。这些读取工具开源版都已经有，只缺一个「列出和读取元数据与草稿」。
- **MCP 问数也是同一个模式，而且服务器端基本到位：**
  - `list_datasets` 一次返回指标、显示名、同义词和命中情况；
  - `query_dataset` 自带出处。
  - 剩下的是几个已知缺口和文档漏写。
- **开源问数评测的框架已经有：** 用订阅登录的 Claude Code、机械打分。但 9 张公开场景卡没有一张用到指标数据集，「按同义词选指标、口径含糊时先反问」这条路现在完全没测到。
- **商业上：** 模型费用由用户自己出，我们零成本。云端和企业版保留智能搭建层、产品内 AI、治理和托管。要改的规定只有一处：定价表开源一栏的「MCP build」从「— source mode」改为「草稿写入口」。
- **需要你做的：** 对 D1–D7 逐条回字母，都同意推荐就回「全部 A」。

## Evidence (objectstack `origin/main` 62d9d0d99, cloud `origin/main` d049c81db)

- **Version discovery**
  - MCP `initialize` reports `serverInfo.version` from the `@objectstack/mcp` package (`packages/mcp/src/package-version.ts`). Discovery and `/health` report a runtime version (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/discovery-version.ts`).
  - All `@objectstack/*` packages release at one shared version (`skills/README.md`), so the server version is the skills/spec version.
  - Nothing in OSS tells the client "install skills/spec at X". Only the cloud door states `Published skills: @objectstack/skills <version>` (cloud `service-ai-studio/src/skills/authoring-source.ts:93`).
- **Local packages**
  - `@objectstack/skills` 18.5.0: 11 SKILL.md files, ~240KB.
  - `@objectstack/spec` publishes `src/**/*.zod.ts`, `json-schema/`, `llms.txt`, `prompts/`.
  - `skills/objectstack-query/rules/{aggregation,filters,pagination}.md`.
- **Client-side lint:** `@objectstack/lint` rules are pure `(stack) => Finding[]` functions (`packages/lint/README.md`). The same table runs at the server save door (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` header).
- **A self-hosted deploy already exists.**
  - `os environments use-runtime <url> --token <key>` then `os deploy` installs through the runtime's install-local door: upgrade plan, `--dry-run`, confirmation (`packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` §"A self-hosted runtime target", `environments/use-runtime.ts`; landed 2026-11-07).
  - `os meta register` does an active `PUT /meta/:type/:name`, with `--force` for `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` (`commands/meta/register.ts:60-77`).
  - Only the MCP door withholds authoring from API keys (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` ~2440-2452).
- **Draft plumbing is OSS.**
  - `saveMetaItem({mode:'draft'})` (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts` ~535/595); authoring surface `'mcp'` (`spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:551`); `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` refused without `force` (`protocol-save.ts` ~1102-1184).
  - REST `PUT/DELETE /api/v1/meta/:type/:name`, `GET /meta/_drafts`, `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts|discard-drafts`.
  - Studio draft review lives under MIT `ui/`.
  - The door seam exists: `registerAuthoringTools` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`). The OSS dispatcher passes no `authoring` (`runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`).
- **The 问数 server side is mostly built.**
  - `list_datasets({terms})` returns labels, descriptions, synonyms and exact `matches` (`spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts:55-75`).
  - `query_dataset` returns `provenance`, `rowCount`, `truncated`, never SQL (`:226-285`).
  - The served SKILL.md teaches metric versus object, ask-back and fallback statement (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts:265-291`).
  - `describe_object` serves options as value plus label (`mcp-http-tools.ts` ~2581-2590).
- **Docs gap:** `packages/mcp/README.md`, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` and `skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md` never mention the dataset tools.
- **Eval harness:**
  - `@objectstack/scenarios` has an `ask` mode. It drives Claude Code on a subscription login, refuses API-billed keys, talks to `/api/v1/mcp` with per-persona keys, and grades correct / cited / leaks.
  - None of the 9 open cards in `docs/qa/scenarios/*.json` declares a dataset or synonym. There is no schedule.
- **Cloud build door:** ~25k lines of proprietary AI Studio tools, all staging through OSS `saveMetaItem` drafts.
- **Policy:** cloud `pricing.md:113` lists "MCP build — source mode" in the OSS column. Line 409 says the mechanisms are open and the paid part is the hosted experience plus governance.

## Design: building (OSS)

- **Read locally:** authoring rules (skills), type contracts (spec zod and `json-schema/`), lint.
- **Read from the server:** app facts only, through `list_objects`, `describe_object`, `list_datasets`, plus one new read, `list_metadata` / `get_metadata` (type, name, draft or published).
- **Write, under `metadata:write`, through the existing seam with an OSS registry:**
  - `save_metadata_draft({type, name, item, package?, ifMatch?})` → `saveMetaItem({mode:'draft', surface:'mcp', client})`;
  - `delete_metadata_draft`;
  - `list_drafts`.
- **No publish tool** (#32591 A). The reply names the Studio review link.
- **Destructive changes:** a draft executes nothing. The plan and the `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` confirmation stay at the human publish step, so the tool has no `force`.
- **Permission and audit:** the `metadata:write` scope plus `manage_metadata` on the user. Draft provenance records surface, OAuth client and user.
- **Validation:** local `os lint` (plus a new single-item `os lint --item file.json`) for fast feedback. The save door stays authoritative and returns structured findings. No server-side "verify" tool in OSS.
- **Version skew:** `initialize` instructions and discovery state `Authoring contract: @objectstack/spec <version>`. The write tool takes an optional `clientSpecVersion`.
- **Server-served rules:** no rule text over MCP in OSS. The served SKILL.md gains a short "to build: install `@objectstack/skills@<version>`" section.
- **Code-first users** keep `os deploy` to self-hosted. The docs show both paths side by side: project-as-code (deploy) and live environment (MCP drafts).
- **Stays cloud/EE:** `apply_blueprint`, `apply_edit`, `create_seed`, `verify_build`, tiered allow-lists (ADR-0112), the rule index with auto-surfacing, quotas and rate limits, the in-product AI.

## Design: 问数 (OSS)

- **The client, taught by skills:** lifts the user's terms, calls `list_datasets`, asks back on ambiguity, formats citations, renders labels.
  - That text lives only in the served SKILL.md today. Move it into `skills/objectstack-ai` and `skills/objectstack-query`, with local and served copies generated from one source.
- **The server guarantees:**
  - row and field security (exists);
  - labels beside raw values in `query_records` / `aggregate_records` results (#33824, p1, OSS remainder);
  - a structured "not a declared metric" marker on fallback (#33752, p3 → p2);
  - the correct formula-aggregate remedy (#34414, p3 → p2, because it steers the client wrong);
  - row caps and `truncated` (exist);
  - the cross-object cap (#33626, p2) and multi-hop (#33619, p3) stay.
- **No new "question context" tool.** `list_datasets({terms})` already is one. Measure tokens first.
- **Measurement:**
  - `@objectstack/scenarios --modes ask`, daily, as a scheduled Claude Code task on the subscription. There is no API cost.
  - Extend 2–3 open cards with datasets, synonyms, an ambiguous pair and a no-match fallback.
  - Add graders `metric-selected`, `asked-back` and `fallback-labelled`.
  - Port the cloud question *kinds*, the ambiguous kind above all, not the cloud fixture.
- **New cards after the ruling:**
  - docs and skills for the dataset tools (p2);
  - dataset scenario cards and graders (p1: this path is unmeasured today);
  - the daily ask schedule (p2);
  - a token audit of `tools/list` and the served SKILL.md (p3).

## Business

- **The boundary effect is small.** OSS can already apply metadata by key over REST and deploy, so an MCP draft door adds convenience, not a new power. Cloud/EE keeps the smart layer, the non-developer AI, governance and hosting.
- **Cost:** bring-your-own AI, so no model cost to us. The main cost is support.
- **Cannibalization:** low for Team, whose users are non-developers. Moderate for EE's MCP build; mitigated because EE keeps blueprints, verify, tiers and quotas.
- **Competitor norm** (triage's web check):
  - NocoBase ships an official MCP server plugin in its free Community edition, aimed at building systems with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
  - Supabase's official MCP server is Apache-2.0 with schema-migration tools.
  - Salesforce offers hosted, admin-enabled metadata MCP servers.

## Decision points: reply with a letter each; "全部 A" accepts every recommendation

- **D1. Amend the policy** (`pricing.md:113`, and the ADR-0025/0082 wording).
  - **A (rec)** OSS gets the "MCP draft write entry"; smart building stays cloud/EE.
  - B no change.
- **D2. Drafts only, or direct apply, on the self-hosted MCP door.**
  - **A (rec)** drafts only. Direct apply already exists through `os deploy` / `os meta register`.
  - B direct apply as well.
- **D3. Credentials for the write entry.**
  - **A (rec now)** OAuth `metadata:write` only.
  - B API keys as well.
  - C ADR-0151 service accounts, once adopted (recommended later).
  - Note: REST already accepts keys for active saves. That inconsistency deserves its own ruling.
- **D4. Version skew.**
  - **A (rec)** refuse a different major, with the install command; advise on a different minor. Stored-item validation stays the final gate.
  - B advise only.
  - C refuse any mismatch.
- **D5. Rules and prompts.**
  - **A (rec)** the OSS server points to the local package; the served SKILL.md keeps the data loop only, generated from one source.
  - B the server keeps serving the full text.
- **D6. 问数 question set.**
  - **A (rec)** extend the open scenario cards with datasets, borrowing the cloud kinds.
  - B port the cloud ask-accuracy fixture.
- **D7. Order.**
  - **A (rec)** 问数 first, since its server side is nearly complete.
  - B building first.

## Milestones

- **M1 (问数):**
  - docs and skills for the dataset tools;
  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#33824 OSS remainder, objectstack-ai/objectstack#33752, objectstack-ai/objectstack#34414;
  - dataset scenario cards and graders;
  - the daily ask run.
- **M2 (build door):**
  - the version statement in `initialize` and discovery;
  - the OSS draft tools plus `list_metadata` / `get_metadata`;
  - single-item lint;
  - the policy amendment (D1).
- **M3:**
  - a build-over-draft-door eval mode;
  - side-by-side docs for deploy and MCP drafts;
  - revisit D3-C.

## Risks

- **Runtime-dead metadata:** without the cloud rule index, a draft door may stage metadata that passes clean but does nothing at runtime. Mitigation: save-door lint coverage, measured in M3.
- **Skills drift** between the served and local copies until D5's single source lands.
- **Daily eval noise:** single-run ask scores ranged 84.8–93%, so use repeats.

## Not verified

- The token weight of `tools/list` and of the rendered SKILL.md (nothing was run).
- Whether an OAuth MCP token is accepted on REST `/meta`.
- That Studio's draft review UI works with no cloud packages present.
- Exact line numbers near `mcp-server-runtime.ts` ~1695 and `runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` ~246; they were read a few commits behind `origin/main`.
